newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Alleged Italian mobster arrested in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Alleged Italian mobster arrested in Brazil.

text.p: An alleged Italian mobster wanted back home on murder and extortion charges was arrested on Tuesday in Rio de Janeiro while attempting to board a plane for Rome using a false passport, police said.

Clemente Ferrara, 45, told Brazilian police he entered the country illegally four years ago. Ferrara insisted his actual name was Paulo Giglioli, but was travelling with a fake passport bearing the name Carmine Trinchillo, police said in a statement.
According to the Brazilian office of the international police agency Interpol, Ferrara is wanted by a court in Naples on murder and extortion charges.
He is allegedly a member of the Camorra mafia family and is accused of assassinating the head of the rival family Grimaldi in 1992, the statement said.
